items.bridge: Exact contained preparation now requires an explicit tracked-execution or coordination-only disposition. Tracked work inherits the exact action, project relation, optional date, and authenticated-self assignment into a deduplicated Task while leaving the source line open; coordination-only work completes only the exact source line. This intentional replacement grants no approval, connected compiler, continuation, provider write, readiness, verification, or health authority.

Project Work Promotion now selects the exact Notion collection references, shared policy sources, authorities, and effect policies in one governed configuration. This ownership does not grant connected write behavior.

Projects Context owns exact portable Project, milestone, embedded work-item, feed-entry, Decision, Question, policy, and document-work meaning independently from Tasks. Project creation is a separate intentionally unavailable Project Capture action held with COMPLETE_PROJECT_READBACK_UNAVAILABLE; it is not a bridge to legacy behavior.

Tasks Context owns portable Task, assignment, date, lifecycle, policy, and Project-link meaning independently from Projects Context. This intentional replacement grants no provider or execution authority.
